text: 1) Passport Homepage (Over one-year availability). If the validity of the applicant's current passport does not meet the requirement, please apply for a new passport before submitting the application.2) Highest graduation certificate. If the applicant is currently a student, the pre-graduation certificate issued by the school is required. Non-Chinese/English documents must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations.3) Stamped Transcript of the highest diploma. Non-Chinese/English documents must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations.4) HSK Transcript for Chinese-taught programs and IELTS\TOEFL for English-taught programs, or other documents to prove your linguistic competence.5) Non-criminal record in Chinese/English with an official stamp. The issue date shall be after October 1, 2024.6) Physical Examination Record. Applicants should strictly check the items in accordance with the requirement of Physical Examination Record.pdf Incomplete records or those without the signature of the attending doctor, the official stamp of the hospital, or a sealed photograph of the applicants are invalid. The date shall be after October 1, 2024. The original piece is required during registration.7) Self-introduction video. Applicants are required to upload a self-introduction video within one minute, and the holder of HSK certificate must use Chinese to record the video. The video must be in MP4 format with a capacity of less than 40MB. Applicants involved can, with the help of video format conversion software, adjust the resolution ratio, bit rate, and other indexes to adjust the file size.8) Statement of not receiving any scholarships or forms of funding. e.g. Personal Statement.docx9) Two different recommendation letters from professors/associate professors with detailed contacts. The signature date shall be after October 1, 2024.10) Study Plan of no less than 1000 words. Please clarify your research background, method, content, and significance, etc. in the future study.The proposal of a doctoral student shall be signed by the applicant's supervisor in CSU.e.g. Study Plan for International Graduates.docx11) Acceptance letter. e.g. Acceptance Letter.docx (contact info: CSU Profs contact.pdf)12) Published essays, CV or any other supporting materials. (for graduate applicants only)
